doctrines.note: Veterancy: Full Top for most situations / Full Bot if using the re-build tech (mostly only competitive). Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. 'Don't put': damage doctrines -- OP verbatim: "don't scale because they don't apply to the cannons the unit places, stack HP / Special instead." Playstyle: Lionroar Crew is a slow-moving unit (especially with cannons deployed) that joins the 'Exotics' community category (units with unique abilities that significantly influence battles, similar to Zykalian Militia, Flamers, Shenji, etc.) -- demands strong teamwork and protection to be effective; if well-guarded, has tremendous potential to impact the battlefield. While its ability to destroy towers/objectives was nerfed, it still excels at some map structures: the bridge on Wall Fort, some gates in other maps, unlocking new strategies. No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond the Playstyle notes (OP gap, not fabricated). OP also links an external Imgur 'Reference image' album not opened/transcribed (out of scope for this read-only capture). Edit timestamp (2026-05-27) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; Lionroar Crew is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only.
